text_blocks.snippet: Taking a COVID-19 test helps you determine if you have an active infection, allowing you to take appropriate steps to protect yourself and others. Knowing your status can guide decisions about treatment options, isolation or quarantine, and preventing further spread of the virus.
snippet_highlighted_words: helps you determine if you have an active infection, allowing you to take appropriate steps to protect yourself and others

text_blocks.snippet: Here's a more detailed look at why testing is beneficial:

list.title: Early treatment:
list.snippet: If you test positive, you can seek early treatment to potentially reduce the severity of illness.

list.title: Infection control:
list.snippet: Knowing you're infected allows you to isolate yourself, reducing the risk of transmitting the virus to others.

list.title: Informed decisions:
list.snippet: Testing helps individuals, communities, and healthcare providers make informed decisions about managing the pandemic.

list.title: Tracking virus spread:
list.snippet: Testing data helps public health officials track the spread of the virus, enabling them to implement appropriate measures.
